about: ✎ PENCIL. Hand-maintained, read by queries.ts. Each query below is what the exhaustive enumeration (research/conformance/) observed on the date given, untriaged: it names the finding and what would settle it, and takes no position on the cause. If findings/triage.json becomes the one home for a finding's status, fold `triaged` and `finding` into it.

defaults.$note: The expectation for any query not named below: the P1.3 properties as stated in issue #1, not observations.

CONFLICT/26b-id+30a.would_settle: A maintainer's reading of Rule 26(a) against the rel:excludes semantics: whether rel:excludes is a claim that the two predicates are disjoint (in which case the predicates or the relation are wrong), or a composition-layer instruction that the excluded entry's lights are not shown (in which case both applying is expected and this check is asking the wrong question).

CONFLICT/26c-id+30a.would_settle: The same reading as FIND-01; the two stand or fall together.

NO-OBLIGATION/any.would_settle: A maintainer's decision on whether position:moored is inside the scope of the lights table at all. Rule 30 names vessels at anchor and aground; facts.json declares position:moored as a value. Either the fact vocabulary is wider than the table intends, or the table is missing a case.

NO-OBLIGATION/not-moored.observed_by: npm run conformance, check consistency-no-obligation, position breakdown: every zero-obligation record was position:moored
